meta.title: Agency: the London UGC agency behind the creators | hypjam
meta.description: hypjam is a UGC agency in London. We brief, cast, direct and edit creator ads rather than handing brands a list of creators. Founded by Avi Aggarwal.

hero.h1: The London UGC agency behind the creators.
hero.intro: hypjam is a UGC agency in London. We brief, cast, direct and edit creator ads, rather than handing brands a list of creators and hoping.

image.alt: Line drawing of hypjam's two-building HQ: the brief desk, the writers' room, the casting floor, the shoot bay and the edit suite

editorial.caption: The five parts of the agency, as drawn on the home page.

sections.h2: Treat UGC like a production, not a marketplace.
paragraphs: Avi Aggarwal started hypjam in London after watching the same thing happen on repeat: brands hiring individual creators one by one, getting inconsistent briefs, inconsistent quality, and no one actually directing the work.

The idea was simple. Treat UGC like a production, not a marketplace. One team handles the brief, the casting, the script, the shoot notes and the edit, so the creator is only focused on delivering a great take, not guessing what the brand wants.

hypjam is built around that idea: direction first, creators second, brand deck never. It is still early days, and the team is growing around the same principle Avi started with. The work should look like it was directed, because it was.

sections.h2: Start from evidence, not a blank page.
sections.p: Most UGC work starts with an empty document and a good feeling: someone writes what they hope a buyer wants to hear, a creator films it, and the brand finds out three weeks later whether the instinct was any good. We start from what is already earning attention in your category, write original scripts around those structures, and let a few days in the feed decide what gets made again. The five steps below are the default, not a condition — if you want it run differently, we build the engagement around that, and still tell you what we think before we start.

items.name: Study the category
items.blurb: The UGC programmes already running in your niche, pulled apart format by format: how a video opens, what the turn is, where the product arrives, how it ends.

items.name: Adapt the format
items.blurb: Fresh scripts for your product, built on the structures that hold up. The pattern is shared; the writing is not. If a script would still work for the brand it came from, it is the wrong script.

items.name: Brief and book the cast
items.blurb: Scripts and reference videos go to the creators cast for that brief, so the format is shown rather than described. Every creator is booked and paid by us, on a signed release.

items.name: Test in the feed
items.blurb: A few days of real attention, then we read them format by format: what held, what got watched to the end, what converted. You run the spend, so the numbers are yours.

items.name: Run the winners again
items.blurb: Formats that perform come back with new creators, new hooks and new angles, for as long as you want them running. The ones that did not hold up are retired.

items.name: Creative director
items.blurb: Owns the brief and the hook: the person making sure every video has a clear idea before anyone presses record.

items.name: Producer and casting
items.blurb: Matches the right creator to the right brief and keeps the sprint on schedule, from first call to final delivery.

items.name: Editor
items.blurb: Turns raw phone footage into a platform-native cut: pacing, captions and sound built for how people actually watch.

items.name: Strategist
items.blurb: Reads what is performing and feeds it back into the next brief, so round two is sharper than round one.

sections.h2: Five things we will not trade.

items.name: Direction over discovery
items.blurb: We are not a search engine for creators. We are the people briefing, shooting and editing the work.

items.name: One team, one contract
items.blurb: No juggling five separate creators and three invoices. One point of contact, start to finish.

items.name: Honest about what is illustrative
items.blurb: We will not invent results to make a story look better. Numbers are labelled for what they are, and empty slots stay empty until they are real.

items.name: Creators are collaborators
items.blurb: Briefed properly, paid properly, treated like the talent they are, not a vending machine for content.

items.name: The work should look directed
items.blurb: Because it was. Every video starts as a script and ends with an edit, not a hope.

founder.name: Avi Aggarwal
founder.quote: We started hypjam because brands kept hiring creators one by one and nobody was directing the work. We treat UGC like a production: one brief, one team, a script before anyone films, an edit built for the feed.

cta.p: Whether you are a brand or a creator, get in touch and we will walk you through how it works.
